LanguageData.TaskBreak_Command_Tip: Stop the selected pawns' current tasks and let them choose what to do next. Queued tasks remain queued.
LanguageData.TaskBreak_Settings_ShowGizmo_Tip: Show the small Break task command for controllable colonists, slaves, children, and overseen colony mechs.
LanguageData.TaskBreak_Settings_ConfirmForced_Tip: Ask before breaking a task the player explicitly forced.
LanguageData.TaskBreak_ConfirmForced: At least one of the {0} selected pawns is doing forced work. Break the safe tasks anyway?
LanguageData.TaskBreak_Reason_NotControlled: This pawn is not under direct player control.
LanguageData.TaskBreak_Reason_Incapacitated: Incapacitated pawns cannot have their task broken.
LanguageData.TaskBreak_Reason_Drafted: Undraft the pawn before breaking a civilian task.
LanguageData.TaskBreak_Reason_Organized: This pawn is taking part in an organized activity.
LanguageData.TaskBreak_Reason_GameProtected: RimWorld or another mod has marked this task uninterruptible.
LanguageData.TaskBreak_Reason_MustComplete: This task must finish before another can begin.
LanguageData.TaskBreak_Reason_Cooldown: Wait a moment before breaking another task.
